title: Find the full names of members who have incurred expenses in more than one
question: Find the full names of members who have incurred expenses in more than one event and whose total expense amount is greater than the average total expense of all members who generated income over $40.

prediction.sql:
WITH member_expense_stats AS (
    SELECT
        m.XCL_034 AS member_id,
        m.XCL_035 AS first_name,
        m.XCL_036 AS last_name,
        SUM(e.XCL_020) AS total_expense,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ev.XCL_010) AS distinct_events
    FROM member m
    INNER JOIN expense e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
    INNER JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
    INNER JOIN event ev ON b.XCL_009 = ev.XCL_010
    GROUP BY m.XCL_034, m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
),
income_qualified_members AS (
    SELECT m.XCL_034 AS member_id
    FROM member m
    INNER JOIN income i ON m.XCL_034 = i.XCL_029
    GROUP BY m.XCL_034
    HAVING SUM(i.XCL_026) > 40
),
avg_expense_threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(me.total_expense) AS avg_total_expense
    FROM member_expense_stats me
    INNER JOIN income_qualified_members iq ON me.member_id = iq.member_id
)
SELECT
    me.first_name,
    me.last_name
FROM member_expense_stats me
CROSS JOIN avg_expense_threshold at
WHERE me.distinct_events > 1
  AND me.total_expense > at.avg_total_expense

WITH member_expense_stats AS (
    SELECT
        m.XCL_034 AS member_id,
        m.XCL_035 AS first_name,
        m.XCL_036 AS last_name,
        SUM(e.XCL_020) AS total_expense,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ev.XCL_010) AS distinct_events
    FROM member m
    INNER JOIN expense e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
    INNER JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
    INNER JOIN event ev ON b.XCL_009 = ev.XCL_010
    GROUP BY m.XCL_034, m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
),
income_qualified_members AS (
    SELECT m.XCL_034 AS member_id
    FROM member m
    INNER JOIN income i ON m.XCL_034 = i.XCL_029
    GROUP BY m.XCL_034
    HAVING SUM(i.XCL_026) > 40
),
avg_expense_threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(me.total_expense) AS avg_total_expense
    FROM member_expense_stats me
    INNER JOIN income_qualified_members iq ON me.member_id = iq.member_id
)
SELECT
    me.first_name,
    me.last_name
FROM member_expense_stats me
CROSS JOIN avg_expense_threshold at
WHERE me.distinct_events > 1
  AND me.total_expense > at.avg_total_expense

avg_total AS (
    SELECT AVG(me.total_expense) AS avg_expense
    FROM member_expenses me
    INNER JOIN income_members im ON me.member_id = im.member_id
)
SELECT me.first_name || ' ' || me.last_name AS full_name
FROM member_expenses me
CROSS JOIN avg_total at
WHERE me.distinct_events > 1
  AND me.total_expense > at.avg_expense

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_035 || ' ' || m.XCL_036 AS full_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
WHERE m.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT e2.XCL_022
    FROM expense e2
    JOIN budget b2 ON e2.XCL_023 = b2.XCL_003
    GROUP BY e2.XCL_022
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2.XCL_009) > 1
)
AND (
    SELECT SUM(e3.XCL_020)
    FROM expense e3
    WHERE e3.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034
) > (
    SELECT AVG(total_exp)
    FROM (
        SELECT e4.XCL_022, SUM(e4.XCL_020) AS total_exp
        FROM expense e4
        WHERE e4.XCL_022 IN (
            SELECT i.XCL_029
            FROM income i
            GROUP BY i.XCL_029
            HAVING SUM(i.XCL_026) > 40
        )
        GROUP BY e4.XCL_022
    )
)

react.raw_react_sql:
WITH member_expense_stats AS (
    SELECT
        m.XCL_034 AS member_id,
        m.XCL_035 AS first_name,
        m.XCL_036 AS last_name,
        SUM(e.XCL_020) AS total_expense,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ev.XCL_010) AS distinct_events
    FROM member m
    INNER JOIN expense e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
    INNER JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
    INNER JOIN event ev ON b.XCL_009 = ev.XCL_010
    GROUP BY m.XCL_034, m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
),
income_qualified_members AS (
    SELECT m.XCL_034 AS member_id
    FROM member m
    INNER JOIN income i ON m.XCL_034 = i.XCL_029
    GROUP BY m.XCL_034
    HAVING SUM(i.XCL_026) > 40
),
avg_expense_threshold AS (
    SELECT AVG(me.total_expense) AS avg_total_expense
    FROM member_expense_stats me
    INNER JOIN income_qualified_members iq ON me.member_id = iq.member_id
)
SELECT
    me.first_name,
    me.last_name
FROM member_expense_stats me
CROSS JOIN avg_expense_threshold at
WHERE me.distinct_events > 1
  AND me.total_expense > at.avg_total_expense
